title: Global value chains, job creation and job destruction among firms in South Africa
summary: Using data on all formal firms in South Africa, the paper finds that integration into global value chains is linked to a net gain in jobs at the firm level. The net gain is mostly driven by firms entering GVCs, while continuing GVC firms show an overall net job loss.
keyFindings: GVC integration is associated with net job gains at the firm level.
The gain is driven by firms entering GVCs; continuing GVC firms show a net job loss.
Suggestive evidence points to a role for firm age and size.
methods: Firm-level panel data from the South African Revenue Service and National Treasury, with job creation and destruction measured following Haltiwanger et al. (2014).
